method: Production pure locomotion, source selection and listener geometry. No mocked Web Audio graph. Native waveform/panning/render verification remains pending.

tests.name: Footfalls follow equal actual travel at30/60/144Hz, with alternating feet
Raised paving uses its own step surface and exact passed location
Held movement against a wall produces no footfalls without physical travel
Muted, paused, airborne and in-vehicle movement never produces walking steps
Landing emits once after genuine airborne time; curb jitter does not
Pause clears airborne/stride history without a phantom landing on resume
Teleport-sized displacement is rejected without catching up steps next frame
Reverse/strafe travel uses distance; invalid values remain finite
Spatial pool selects at most six valid actual sources and filters wrecks/waiting/hidden/far sources
Source retention avoids swapping voices for tiny nearest-distance changes
Listener forward/up form the actual yaw/pitch orthonormal camera basis
Six procedural neighborhood profiles are distinct and bounded
Construction/update remain silent without creating an AudioContext
